en.title: Hindsight Memory-PRM: Supervising Memory Management with Auditable Hindsight Credit
en.hook: A novel Process Reward Model that supervises long-horizon LLM agent memory operations using machine-readable hindsight evidence.
key_takeaways: Solves unobservable reward estimation for long-horizon memory operations.
Leverages trajectory evidence for auditable hindsight credit assignment.
Enhances agent memory control for retrieval, updates, and pruning.
